name: Stripe
description: The Stripe CLI project (each is an account the CLI is logged in to, from `stripe login --project-name <name>`), for dev servers that run `stripe listen`. Profiles set STRIPE_PROJECT_NAME for their servers. There's no command to change the machine-wide default, so switch it per profile.

fields.label: Project
fields.list: awk -F"'" '/^\[.*\]$/ { if (p != "") print p "\t" d; p = substr($0, 2, length($0) - 2); d = "" } p != "" && /^display_name *=/ { d = $2 } END { if (p != "") print p "\t" d }' "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/stripe/config.toml"
fields.current: awk -F"'" 'BEGIN { p = "default" } /^\[/ { exit } /^project-name *=/ { p = $2 } END { print p }' "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/stripe/config.toml" 2>/dev/null || echo default
